cm_28b.caption: [MAP linked at D] D - The eight-inch guns were here at St. Peter's Head, Battery No. 1. There is a two-story underground ready ammunition bunker.
cm_28b.credit: Map: 1944 Harbor Defense Project of Kodiak (declassified), via kadiak.org

cm_46b.caption: [MAP linked at E] E - WW II Distant Electrical Control bunker on Bald Hill (Site 3) between St. Peters Head and Cape Chiniak. View to the east. Controls searchlight No. 8. Photo by j0e circa 1985.
cm_46b.credit: Map: 1944 Harbor Defense Project of Kodiak (declassified), via kadiak.org

cm_24b.caption: [MAP linked at N] N - WWII SCR-296A radar site.
cm_24b.credit: Map: 1944 Harbor Defense Project of Kodiak (declassified), via kadiak.org

cm_32b.caption: [MAP linked at P] P - Cape Greville site of WWII B3/2. This site is reached via a spur road that is somewhat overgrown. (Possible WWII loran site.)
cm_32b.credit: Map: 1944 Harbor Defense Project of Kodiak (declassified), via kadiak.org

cm_30b.caption: R - Soquel Point Searchlights 3,4, DEC, B3/1.
cm_30b.credit: Map: 1944 Harbor Defense Project of Kodiak (declassified), via kadiak.org
